author: lbaumdeveloper
name: spkl Tooling for an existing solution
description: Adds only the spkl Tooling project (spkl.json, spkl.ps1), VS Code tasks and nuget.config to an existing Visual Studio solution. Run it in the folder that contains the .sln.

SolutionUniqueName.description: Unique name of the Dynamics 365 solution your plugins and web resources already belong to. Never the default solution.

FeedUrl.description: NuGet source of the Spkl.OnPrem packages, e.g. https://gitlab.contoso.local/api/v4/projects/42/packages/nuget/index.json or https://nuget.pkg.github.com/lbaumdeveloper/index.json. Written to nuget.config without credentials.

NuGetConfig.description: Create nuget.config. Use false if the solution already has one and add the spkl source to it yourself.

VsCodeTasks.description: Create .vscode/tasks.json. Use false if the solution already has one and copy the spkl tasks into it yourself.

postActions.description: Add the Tooling project to the solution in this folder.

manualInstructions.text: Run 'dotnet sln add Tooling/Tooling.csproj' in the folder that contains the .sln.
